name: QTask_DestroyTask_4015F0

reviewer.method: instruction-level review against the committed section 18 tiling plus emitted-listing codegen checks

checks.detail: Extent 0x004015F0-0x00401776 (391 bytes) from the cross-decoded tiling; 25 blocks and 37 edges match retail exactly (bn 25/37, r2 25/37, score 1.000).
Candidate emits 25 blocks and 37 edges against retail's 25/37; block count did not collapse despite GCC merging retail's two returns.
One dword at all 120 retail call sites; argument is the task object, used as the QTask header and passed unchanged to both handlers, the recursion, 0x004015D0 and 0x004B0D10.
Direct: self at 0x0040165F, unlink 0x004015D0 at 0x004016C5, free 0x004B0D10 at 0x0040176A. Indirect: phase-3 handler 0x0040164F and phase-2 handler 0x00401682 through 0x00A96AE0.
Handler index 3*0x180 and 2*0x180 for phase 3 and 2; class record 0x00AF5EE0 + type*0x30; pooled element address base + index*elemSize.
No floating-point instruction in the retail function.

Codegen checks in the emitted listing: six separate type-word loads at task+0x1C; live-count decrement is the first memory write (subl $1,0x6260A0) and is the same symbol the allocator increments; child-tail load 0x10(%ebx) after the phase-3 call and before the recursive call; the three pool swap stores in retail order A (indices[position]) then B (indices[lastPosition]) then C (*(lastElement+tail)).
Both retail returns are plain ret with no value read by any caller; the candidate declares void, and the two returns appear as the pool-swap early exit and the function end.
No null check, no double-destroy guard, no cycle check and no logging, matching retail; recorded as gap 18.8.4 rather than silently added.

limitations: Static only: no runtime observation of this native, and it is unreachable before the QTask_RegisterClasses boundary.
Retail semantics of the 0x004016E4 class+0x20 word and of the allocator's matching store at 0x0040134E remain unsettled (section 17.7); the candidate reads and writes them literally as retail does.
The dispatch-stack fixup purpose is unproven (section 18.8); the mechanics are transcribed exactly.
